applies_to: synth_dataset.py (default phase-noise model); curves keyed radio/config like isi_taps.json
units: curve: [frequency Hz, S_phi dB(rad^2/Hz)] (one-sided; L(f) dBc/Hz = S_phi - 3.01 dB)
interpolation: linear in dB against log10(f) between knots; drawn at symbol rate (1 MHz) as ONE continuous process per run, then interpolated linearly to sample rate
what_it_is: ONE phase-noise curve per radio/config, 1.5 Hz to 500 kHz, fitted jointly to the in-burst symbol deviation (per radio) and the between-burst preamble phase path (fleet-common per config). Replaces the in-burst pn_mask + close-in points pair.
fit_method: analysis_scripts/fit_pn_curve.py: both measurements are linear in the phase, so their expected values are an exact linear map of the curve (generator grid, preamble average, symbol-rate interpolation + srrc^2 matched-filter smoothing, deramp, Welch); least squares in dB with a light second-difference penalty.
in_burst_measurement: fit_isi_taps.py deviations on DE-SPURRED captures (SG_DESPUR=1): tangential minus radial Welch spectrum, one 1000-symbol burst per segment, mean over the fit runs (D:/repeat, train_runs.json).
path_measurement: Per-burst preamble phase angle(sum rx*conj(tx)) after one constant (median x^4) CFO, unwrapped, quadratic removed, Welch nperseg=256 at the burst rate (766 Hz). Targets are half-octave band means of the real spectrum, as L(f).
common_mode: Six radios: between/within ratio at the label-permutation null, no band consistent across configs; gain has no effect; level scales as 20log10(fc). A shared reference or the receiver LO, not a device fingerprint.
not_modelled: Quadratic in-run tilt is ~0.6-0.9x real (the sub-1.5 Hz band is not constrained); per-burst CFO lag-1 of +0.27..+0.51 at 89_433 only. The receiver spur (1168-sample period) is separate: --rx-spur.
